title: A Study on the Impact of Natural Language Differences in Prompts on Automatic Code Generation Using LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.18311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in automatic code generation tasks, thereby encouraging new research in this area. Although numerous studies have explored LLM-based code generation, the impact of the natural language in input prompts remains unexplored (language bias). This study aims to (1) quantify how the natural language of input prompts influences LLM-based code generation performance and (2) evaluate a mitigation strategy to reduce language bias in code generation. We assess code generation Accuracy on AtCoder, LeetCode, and BigCodeBench. To quantify the language bias on code generation, each problem is presented in English, Japanese, and Chinese. We use seven LLMs (GPT-4o, o3-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3, Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B, and GitHub Copilot) and assess their performance in terms of Accuracy (the number of problems for which generated code passes all test cases). translated_title: 一项关于提示词中自然语言差异对基于大语言模型的自动代码生成影响的研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在自动代码生成任务中展现出了卓越的性能，从而推动了该领域的新研究。尽管已有大量研究探讨了基于大语言模型的代码生成，但输入提示词中自然语言的影响（语言偏差）仍未得到探索。本研究旨在：（1）量化输入提示词的自然语言如何影响基于大语言模型的代码生成性能；（2）评估一种减少代码生成中语言偏差的缓解策略。我们在AtCoder、LeetCode和BigCodeBench上评估代码生成的准确率。为了量化代码生成中的语言偏差，每道题目分别以英语、日语和中文呈现。我们使用了七个大语言模型（GPT-4o、o3-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B、Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B和GitHub Copilot），并以准确率（生成代码通过所有测试用例的题目数量）来评估其性能。
tldr: 本研究首次量化了提示词中自然语言（英语、日语、中文）的差异对大语言模型代码生成性能的影响，并评估了缓解这种语言偏差的策略。
en_tdlr: This study quantifies the impact of natural language differences in prompts (English, Japanese, Chinese) on LLM-based code generation performance and evaluates a mitigation strategy to reduce language bias.
